name: Suzumiya Keimu Shoukan
source:
In near future private prisons save the overcrowded penitentiary system. They use prisoners' labor as a means of financing. Main character dreams of director's wife, so he comes up with a revolutionary way to earn money - by using female prisoners as prostitutes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不久后的未来，私人监狱缓解了公共监狱人满为患的问题，并通过囚犯劳动筹措运营资金。主人公觊觎监狱长的妻子，于是想出了一种革命性的赚钱方法：迫使女性囚犯卖淫。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
